The Moen 3887EP is an Eco-Performance hand shower set in Chrome with a single full-spray function, a 30 in. slide bar and a 69 in. metal hose. The maximum flow rate is 1.75 GPM (6.65 L/min), and the set is WaterSense labeled. The slide bar mounts on the shower wall and holds the hand shower at an adjustable height. The hose connects to a wall supply elbow (drop ell), which Moen lists as sold separately, so the set can be added beside a fixed shower head or used as the only shower outlet.

Key Features

  • Single-function hand shower with full spray
  • 1.75 GPM (6.65 L/min) maximum flow, WaterSense labeled
  • 30 in. slide bar with adjustable holder
  • 69 in. metal double interlock spiral hose
  • Chrome finish
  • Eco-Performance water-saving design

What Is Included

  • Hand shower
  • 30 in. slide bar with holder and mounting hardware
  • 69 in. metal hose
  • Not included: drop ell (wall supply elbow). Moen lists it as sold separately
  • Not included: shower valve, trim and diverter

Before You Order

  • Water supply: the hose needs its own outlet in the wall, fed through a drop ell. Plan a diverter or transfer valve if the shower also has a fixed head.
  • Wall space: allow for the 30 in. bar and solid backing or suitable anchors.
  • Flow: 1.75 GPM maximum. Check any local limit on shower flow rate.
  • Backflow: local code may require a vacuum breaker for hand showers; check whether your valve or drop ell provides it.
  • Finish: Chrome. Other finishes carry a suffix after 3887EP.

Specifications

  • Brand: Moen
  • Manufacturer Part #: 3887EP
  • Spray settings: 1
  • Includes: Slide bar
  • Finish: Chrome
  • UPC: 026508222157
  • Category: Hand Shower Heads

See also: hand shower heads, slide bars, shower heads, all Moen products.

The GROHE 2021700A is a Concetto 8 in. widespread two-handle bathroom faucet in the L-size, finished in StarLight Chrome. It installs in three holes with a separate high-arc spout and two metal lever handles. The faucet is WaterSense labeled. GROHE lists a maximum deck thickness of 1-3/16 in.; the overall height is 10-7/16 in. Ceramic disc valves control hot and cold separately, and a drain assembly is supplied with the faucet.

Key Features

  • Concetto collection, GROHE StarLight Chrome finish
  • 8 in. widespread, three-hole deck mount
  • L-size high-arc spout, 10-7/16 in. overall height
  • WaterSense labeled
  • GROHE SilkMove ceramic disc valves
  • Solid brass body with metal lever handles

What Is Included

  • Spout
  • Two lever handles with valves
  • Drain assembly
  • GROHE QuickFix mounting hardware
  • Not included: supply lines to the stops (confirm on GROHE's parts list), shutoff stops and sink

Before You Order

  • Hole layout: three holes for 8 in. widespread spacing. It does not fit 4 in. centerset or single-hole sinks.
  • Deck thickness: 1-3/16 in. maximum per GROHE. Thick stone tops may be over the limit.
  • Reach and height: 10-7/16 in. overall height. Check the height and the spout reach on GROHE's dimension drawing against the bowl and any cabinet or shelf above.
  • Supply connection: confirm the connection size on GROHE's installation sheet before buying supply lines.
  • Size: L-size is the tall version of this faucet.

Specifications

  • Brand: Grohe
  • Manufacturer Part #: 2021700A
  • UPC: 4005176346255
  • Category: Widespread Faucets

  • Not included: Roman tub rough-in valve, sold separately
  • Not included: supply lines and tub drain

  • Hole layout: four holes in the tub deck (spout, two handles, hand shower). Confirm the handle spacing on Moen's installation sheet.

The Moen 62320 is an M-PACT Posi-Temp pressure-balancing rough-in valve for single-handle tub and shower installations piped in copper. All four ports are 1/2 in. CC (copper sweat) connections on a brass body, and the valve has no integral stops. A test plug is pre-installed, and the Moen 1222 Posi-Temp cartridge is supplied with the valve. Handle, escutcheon, shower head and tub spout are not part of this item and come with the trim kit you choose.

Key Features

  • Posi-Temp pressure-balancing valve that reacts to hot or cold supply pressure changes
  • M-PACT platform: the valve stays in the wall and the trim can be changed later
  • 1/2 in. CC sweat connections on inlets and outlets
  • Brass 4-port body for tub and shower or shower-only layouts
  • Pre-installed test plug for pressure testing the rough plumbing
  • Adjustable temperature limit stop
  • Moen 1222 Posi-Temp cartridge included

What Is Included

  • Posi-Temp rough-in valve body, brass, 4-port, 1/2 in. CC sweat
  • Moen 1222 Posi-Temp pressure-balancing cartridge
  • Pre-installed test plug
  • Adjustable temperature limit stop
  • Not included: handle, escutcheon, shower head, shower arm and tub spout (part of a Posi-Temp trim kit, sold separately)
  • Not included: shutoff stops, solder fittings and piping

Before You Order

  • Trim: this is the in-wall valve only. Order a Moen Posi-Temp trim kit separately and confirm on the trim's specification sheet that it lists M-PACT Posi-Temp valves.
  • Connections: 1/2 in. CC sweat, for soldering to copper tube. For PEX or threaded pipe choose another M-PACT Posi-Temp model or use adapters.
  • Soldering: follow Moen's installation instructions for protecting the valve from heat.
  • Stops: this model has no integral stops. Check whether your code or building requires stops at the valve.
  • Wall depth: set the valve to the finished-wall dimension shown on Moen's installation sheet, allowing for tile or surround thickness.
  • Local code: confirm the maximum outlet temperature setting required in your area and set the temperature limit stop at installation.

Specifications

  • Brand: Moen
  • Manufacturer Part #: 62320
  • Valve: M-Pact Posi-Temp
  • Type: Tub and shower valve
  • Connection: Sweat
  • UPC: 026508009208
  • Category: Shower and Tub-Shower Valves

See also: shower and tub-shower valves, pressure balance valve trims, tub and shower trim sets, all Moen products.

  • Adjustable temperature limit stop

  • Moen 1222 Posi-Temp pressure-balancing cartridge
  • Test plug
  • Adjustable temperature limit stop

  • Stops: this is the version with stops. Models without stops are listed separately.

The GROHE 35110000 is a GrohSafe 3.0 pressure balance rough-in valve with integrated service stops, the in-wall body for GROHE single-handle pressure balance shower trims. The body is DZR brass with 1/2 in. universal inlets and 1/2 in. outlets. It is supplied with a flush plug so the lines can be tested and flushed before the cartridge is fitted. The cartridge is not in this box: it ships with the trim. The rough-in depth range is 1-3/4 in. to 2-3/4 in. from the finished wall to the back of the valve.

Key Features

  • GrohSafe 3.0 pressure balance valve body in DZR brass
  • Integrated service stops
  • 1/2 in. universal inlets and 1/2 in. outlets
  • Flush plug for testing with air (200 psi) or water (300 psi)
  • Stainless steel retaining ring holds the plug and cartridge without screws
  • Flat back for mounting against a cross brace; hot and cold can be reversed for back-to-back installations
  • Plaster guard that also serves as an installation guide

What Is Included

  • GrohSafe 3.0 pressure balance valve body
  • Flush plug
  • Integrated service stops
  • Stainless steel retaining ring
  • Plaster guard
  • Not included: pressure balance cartridge (ships with the trim)
  • Not included: handle and escutcheon. A GrohSafe 3.0 pressure balance trim with cartridge, such as the GROHE 14468000 Concetto trim, is sold separately

Before You Order

  • Trim: buy a GROHE GrohSafe 3.0 pressure balance trim that includes the cartridge. Without it the valve cannot operate.
  • Rough-in depth: 1-3/4 in. to 2-3/4 in. from the finished wall to the back of the valve.
  • Connections: 1/2 in. Check GROHE's specification sheet for the sweat and thread options on inlets and outlets against your piping.
  • Pressure: GROHE lists a minimum flow pressure of 20 psi and a maximum operating pressure of 125 psi.
  • Version: 35112000 is another GrohSafe pressure balance rough-in listed in this store. Compare connections and stops before ordering.

Specifications

  • Brand: Grohe
  • Manufacturer Part #: 35110000
  • UPC: 4005176574443
  • Category: Shower and Tub-Shower Valves

The GROHE 3134910E is a Concetto single-handle pull-down kitchen faucet with dual spray in StarLight Chrome. It mounts on the deck through one hole and is 15-1/16 in. high overall, with a spout that swivels 360 degrees. A toggle button on the spray head switches between a regular stream and a spray. A GROHE SilkMove ceramic cartridge controls flow and temperature from one lever, and the SpeedClean nozzles can be wiped to remove limescale.

  • GROHE EcoJoy water-saving technology
  • Single-hole deck mount with one lever handle

  • SpeedClean nozzles

What Is Included

  • Faucet with pull-down spray head and hose
  • Lever handle
  • GROHE QuickFix Plus mounting hardware
  • Not included: deck plate (escutcheon) for three-hole sinks
  • Not included: shutoff stops, soap dispenser, sink and drain parts

Before You Order

  • Holes: needs one hole. A three-hole sink needs a separate escutcheon; confirm the GROHE part number before ordering.
  • Clearance: 15-1/16 in. overall height. Measure to any cabinet, shelf or window sill above the sink.
  • Reach: check the spout reach on GROHE's dimension drawing against your bowl.
  • Flow: check the flow rate on GROHE's specification sheet against any local limit. A similar Concetto pull-down, model 32665003, is a separate product.
  • Deck thickness and supply connections: confirm on GROHE's installation sheet.

Specifications

  • UPC: 4005176466779
  • Category: Pull-Out Faucets

  • Lever handle
